name: authentication_billing
problem: A paying user must map to both an auth principal and a Stripe customer, and the two must stay in sync.
glue: On user signup, lazily create a Stripe customer and store stripe_customer_id on the user. On Stripe webhooks, resolve events back to the user by that id.
steps: Add stripe_customer_id (nullable) to the users model.
In auth_routes signup (or first checkout), call stripe_checkout to create/fetch the customer and persist the id.
In stripe_webhooks, look up the user by stripe_customer_id before mutating subscription_status.
Guard billing routes with the authentication dependency so only the owner acts on their subscription.
